profile.account_caption: Your watchlist, portfolio ledger and preferences are attached to this account — other users of this app never see them. Data folder: `{folder}`.
profile.language_caption: Sets the interface language. Auto follows your browser's language; pick one to override it on every device.
profile.currency_caption: Converts the Portfolio headline figures at the latest FX rate. Tax figures stay in EUR — Spanish fiscal rules are euro-denominated.
profile.watchlist_caption: Drives Overview, Screener, Earnings and the ticker picker. Add or remove rows and hit **Save**. `shares` + `cost` make an entry a position for the equal-weight fallback analytics; the real book still comes from imported transactions. Alert rules on kept tickers are preserved. Crypto goes in as a Yahoo pair symbol — `BTC-USD`, `ETH-EUR` — never a bare coin code (bare codes collide with stock tickers).
profile.watchlist_empty: Watchlist is empty — add a row below (**+** at the bottom of the table), type a ticker like `AAPL`, and hit **Save**. Overview, Screener and Earnings come alive as soon as one ticker is in.
profile.col_avg_cost_help: Average buy price per share, in the stock's native currency
profile.col_tags_help: Comma-separated groups, e.g. `semis, EM` — the ticker picker search matches them
